meta.name: new-term-radar
meta.description: One run from signal to decision. Finds the names of new AI models, products and repositories seen in the last 24 hours (X, Hugging Face, GitHub, sitemaps), then builds a keyword priority table for them, each new name and the generic search terms behind it, sized against Google Ads volume and DataForSEO Trends (an estimate of Google search interest), with prioritize, watch or skip. Use when the user wants today's new AI keywords, an AI trend radar, or asks what new AI terms are worth building a page or tool for. Also takes names the user already has. Runs the new-term-radar command line; needs an AISA_API_KEY.
